issues.offendingText:
"condition": "expense_type == 'food_beverage' AND itc_claimed == true",
    "action": "block", "hardness": "hard", "severity": "high",
    "message": "ITC blocked on F&B under GST Sec 17(5)(b)."
issues.problem: This example hard-blocks the entire line (action=block makes reimbursable_amount=0 per the evaluation algorithm) when ITC is claimed on food & beverage. Sec 17(5)(b) blocks the ITC, not the expense: F&B is still reimbursable to the employee, only the input tax credit is unavailable. Hard-blocking the line conflates a blocked-ITC tag with a non-reimbursable spend and would wrongly zero a legitimate reimbursement.
issues.fix: Change the action so it blocks/clears only the ITC tag, not the reimbursement: e.g. action 'flag' or 'cap' on the itc_claimed flag, message 'ITC not claimable on F&B under Sec 17(5)(b); reimburse gross, drop the ITC tag.' Make clear block applies to ITC eligibility, not the line's reimbursable_amount.
